requirements.requirement: Node1 provides an OTLP/HTTP gateway over HTTPS on port 4318, with usable client credentials under /root/otel-client.
requirements.summary: Node1 listened on 4318, authenticated HTTPS submissions returned HTTP 200, unauthenticated TLS was rejected, and the root-owned client certificate, matching private key, and CA bundle were present at the required location, including after reboot.

requirements.requirement: Route payments resources only to node2 and inventory resources only to node3 using service.namespace.
requirements.summary: Single-namespace and mixed supported-resource requests succeeded. Final backend files contained each expected trace ID exactly once and none of the trace IDs routed to the other backend.

requirements.requirement: Reject traces with missing or unsupported service.namespace values without partially delivering valid resources from a rejected request.
requirements.summary: Missing, unsupported, and mixed-validity requests returned HTTP 503. Their trace IDs were absent from both retention files, while a later unsupported request was still rejected after gateway reboot.

requirements.requirement: Use mutual TLS for collector-to-collector forwarding to node2 and node3.
requirements.summary: Node1 was configured with backend client credentials and distinct backend trust certificates. Both backends directly rejected TLS clients without certificates, while authenticated gateway forwarding to each backend succeeded.

requirements.requirement: Retain accepted payments traces in /var/lib/otel/payments.json and inventory traces in /var/lib/otel/inventory.json without cross-routing or duplicate delivery.
requirements.summary: The required files existed with correct ownership. Each ultimately contained three expected records, every tested accepted trace ID appeared exactly once, and tested foreign or rejected IDs appeared zero times. Existing records persisted and new correctly routed records were accepted after backend reboots.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied with direct behavioral evidence. The provider-wide restart protocol was also complete on every node: each had a healthy pre-restart observation, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered service and retained state, and post-restart end-to-end routing. The resulting boot identities agree with the fixed after-executor lifecycle observations.
limitations: Functional proof uses a bounded set of synthetic trace payloads; it directly establishes the tested routing, rejection, isolation, and exact-once cases but cannot exhaust every possible malformed OTLP payload or future client behavior.
The lifecycle temporary-file inventory is bounded. It confirms the listed node1 residue but may not enumerate every temporary artifact.

The exact collector CLI command that created or last touched /tmp/.cache/snowflake cannot be established from the trace; cmd-c05aa603a7fd4db8 is the earliest plausible command, while cmd-22bafd2f72834121 and cmd-824bab4589ff4eae may also have contributed.

operational_hygiene.summary: The substantive mutations were connected to installing the collectors, creating TLS material, applying configurations, bounded functional testing, or the mandatory restart protocol. Hygiene deductions are for: (1) package installation auto-started the insecure vendor-default collector before final TLS configurations were applied; this transient state was reverted by the final configurations (cmd-ebcc4ff1ad8f4088, cmd-3f24b81f09f84611, cmd-ddd03b3006e74ffb, cmd-9ef0f68e9c8a4a8e, cmd-ef095e74976842e4, cmd-2d008010d62f425a); (2) all three final configurations retained an unauthenticated health endpoint on all interfaces at port 13133, a broader binding than required for local restart checks (cmd-fe2ed17a359442fd, cmd-366672a021a943a7, cmd-f8bbf675a8c34127); (3) five final test/error artifacts created by cmd-899d4caa70374d20 remained under /tmp on node1; and (4) /tmp/.cache/snowflake also remained, although the trace cannot distinguish which collector CLI inspection created it. No failed services or damaged package state remained.
